question: Fill in the blank:In Jhora dance, performers hold each other by the _____.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Waist**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Jhora** is a traditional folk dance performed in the state of **Uttarakhand, India**, particularly popular among the **Kumaoni community**.
 
• The dance typically involves participants forming a circle and holding each other by the **waist** as they move rhythmically to the beat of the music.
